# The std traits that announce-std mocks, with their signatures.
# Read from the rust-src of rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13) by tools/gen-std.
# Do not edit by hand: run
#   cargo run --manifest-path tools/gen-std/Cargo.toml --target-dir target/gen-std
# announce-std/build.rs keeps the records and items that the compiling rustc has,
# and writes the mocks. The format is described in announce-std/build.rs.

trait hash BuildHasher
path ::core::hash::BuildHasher
since 1.7
std no
derive no
unsafe no
head
note `hash_one` is part of the mock from Rust 1.71, where it became stable. On older
note compilers the mock has `build_hasher` only: hash a value with `x.hash(&mut b.build_hasher())`.
item 1.7 required type Hasher: ::core::hash::Hasher
item 1.7 required fn build_hasher(&self) -> Self::Hasher
item 1.71 provided fn hash_one<T: ::core::hash::Hash>(&self, x: T) -> ::core::primitive::u64 where Self: ::core::marker::Sized, Self::Hasher: ::core::hash::Hasher
